- We can permit logo use on marketing web pages and co-branded case studies, but need to limit press quotes and require pre-approval for any release including customer names.

Subject: Fwd: BrightSky redlines — quick legal review request

Team — forwarding BrightSky's redlines. Key asks from the customer: limited logo use, pre-approval for press quotes, and a possible exception to the embargo for a webinar on April 25.

Quick recap of points I want legal to confirm and propose language for in the Order Form: 
1) Limited publicity license: preferred wording is a 6-month, non-exclusive, revocable license to display logos and brief case-study copy on marketing channels; Pre-approval required for press releases.
2) Quiet period carveout: allow joint webinar on April 25 with their approval, but keep general public launch April 27.
3) Confidentiality carveout: define "publicly available information" and explicitly exclude customer-provided press copy approved in writing.

Can you review the annotated MSA and return a suggested paragraph for the OF by Monday 12pm PT? There are attachments in the original thread (OrderForm redlines, MSA annotations, press draft).

Thanks — I have the customer on a short timeline.

Marissa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-31T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightSky redlines — quick legal review request

Thanks for the summary, Marissa. I reviewed the annotated MSA and BrightSky's OF redlines. High-level guidance: 

- We can accept a limited publicity license scoped to "logo use on Redwood marketing assets and co-branded case studies" with a 30-day approval turnaround for press copy (we should specify 5 business days for minor uses and 10 business days for full press releases).
- The confidentiality carveout should include explicit language: "Customer-provided promotional materials approved in writing by Customer are not Confidential Information for the purposes of publicity." That protects both parties and keeps MSA confidentiality intact.
- Regarding the webinar exception: we can permit a single pre-launch joint webinar (April 25) if BrightSky confirms attendee list and presentation slides 5 business days prior. Add a mutual non-solicit clause for webinar attendee lists.

I'll draft a short OF paragraph and a redline for the MSA confidentiality paragraph. See my notes attached (I'm pasting key lines below). If Laura and Avery are good with the timing, I can share the language with Marissa to send to BrightSky.

Draft paragraph (proposed for Order Form):
"Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, revocable license to use Customer's name and logo on Redwood marketing materials and case studies. Any press release or public announcement quoting Customer requires Customer's prior written approval; Customer shall provide approval or requested edits within 5 business days for minor uses, 10 business days for full press releases. A one-time pre-launch joint webinar on April 25, 2028 is permitted provided Customer approves final slides and attendee list 5 business days prior."

Laura/Avery — please weigh in on the attendee list limitation and whether we should require a limited data retention clause for any shared registrant lists.

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the press draft. Legal and I aligned on wording and can accept the customer-requested limits with one minor change (detailed below). Summary and next steps: 

1) Accepted: Limited logo use on Redwood marketing pages and co-branded case studies; pre-approval required for any press release quoting BrightSky.
2) Accepted: One-time webinar exception for April 25, 2028. Please confirm attendee list and final slides by April 18 (5 business days prior).
3) Small edit requested: we want the approval window to be 5 business days for minor marketing uses and up to 10 business days for full press releases. Please acknowledge in your redline.

Action items for BrightSky: 
- Please return a one-line confirmation in the Order Form redline that you accept the approval timelines and the webinar exception.
- Provide high-resolution logo files and brand usage guidelines (SVG preferred).
- If possible, share the final press copy via the drive link below so we can queue internal comms and legal clearance: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/BR-2028-0421/press-draft

We plan to incorporate the agreed paragraph into the Order Form and attach the annotated MSA as exhibit. Once you confirm, we'll route for signature (DocuSign link included).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if anything is unclear.

Best,
